name: Cherry Access
summary: Sydney dialup/access ISP (Cherry Access Pty Ltd, traded as Cherry Internet); wound down by 2008, company shell renamed ZHONG HUAN PTY LTD and ABN cancelled 1 Oct 2008 (formerly CHERRY ACCESS PTY LTD, ACN 075 816 045).

names.name: Cherry Access
source: https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=61075816045 (ACN 075 816 045; trading name CHERRY INTERNET recorded from 28 Aug 2000; entity later renamed ZHONG HUAN PTY LTD)

events.details: CHERRY ACCESS PTY LTD ACN 075 816 045 registered 30 Sep 1996 as Rising Technology Pty Ltd; traded as Cherry Internet (ABR trading name from 28 Aug 2000); Cynosure listing by Apr 1997.

ABN cancelled 1 Oct 2008; company shell renamed ZHONG HUAN PTY LTD (now a Chinese-language business, NSW 2131). No live retail homepage was ever archived — the earliest Wayback capture (8 Feb 2013) already returns HTTP 403, i.e. the domain was dead/parked by then.
